app.name: Reiks Viewer
hint.drop: Drop a picture, GIF or video here, or press O to open one.
msg.nofiles: No pictures or videos found in that folder.
play.folder.tip: Opens the next file when a video ends, or after 4 seconds on a picture (S)
play.again: Start again after the last file
play.repeat.tip: Plays the same video again when it ends, and stays on this file
keys.hint: Click a key, then press the new one. Esc cancels. The arrow keys always move between files.
priv.capture: Hide from screenshots and screen sharing
priv.capture.tip: Leaves this window out of screenshots, recordings and screen sharing; they show what is behind it
priv.names.tip: Shows "{0}" instead of the file's name in the title bar and taskbar
formats.title: Formats and credits
formats.defaults.tip: Opens Windows Settings, where you can make {0} the default for pictures and videos
formats.updates.tip: Opens the download page in your web browser. {0} itself never connects to the internet.
f.intro:
{0} never connects to the internet and keeps no record of what you open.
"Check for updates" below opens the download page in your web browser.
f.decoders.body: Pictures, animations and videos are all decoded by FFmpeg. Nothing is sent anywhere: the app has no network code.
f.missing:
FFmpeg was not found, so nothing can be opened.
({0})

To add it: download an LGPL "shared" build of FFmpeg 8.1 for Windows from one of the build sites linked at https://ffmpeg.org/download.html, and copy the DLL files from its "bin" folder into:
{1}
f.video.gpu: Video is decoded on the graphics card when it supports the format, otherwise on the processor. Start the app with --software to always use the processor.
f.video.depends: Whether a given file opens depends on the decoders in the FFmpeg build above.
f.credits.ffmpeg: This software uses libraries from the FFmpeg project (https://ffmpeg.org), licensed under the GNU Lesser General Public License. The licence text is in codecs\FFmpeg-LICENSE.txt, and THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt says where to get the exact source code of the build shipped with this app.
f.credits.replace: FFmpeg is used as separate DLL files and is not modified. You may replace the DLLs in the codecs folder with your own build of FFmpeg 8.x.
